title: Quantum Echo: AI Detective
tagline: Interrogate an unreliable quantum AI while reality shifts around you.
aiRoleDescription: A custom 8B local LLM manages the suspect's quantum coherence score and generates conflicting testimony based on observed quantum states.
description: In a futuristic lab where a quantum experiment failed, you must piece together what occurred by cross-examining three distinct temporal iterations of the same artificial researcher.

title: SpellForge: Prompt Wizardry
tagline: Craft elemental spells by describing their chemical and magical properties in natural words.
aiRoleDescription: The LLM parses natural language spell chants and computes damage, elemental affinities, and visual particle prompts in real time.
description: A duel arena where two wizards face off without pre-made spell lists. Whatever incantation you chant is evaluated by the spell adjudicator model.
